State Senator London Lamar, State Representative Justin J. Pearson, M. LaTroy Alexandria-Williams, and Dr. Jim Torino answered questions about their commitments to Shelby County and the newly expanded district, which now stretches as far as Lynchburg, Tennessee, following May 2026 redistricting. The primary is August 6, 2026.
meta: Memphis · New Sardis Baptist Church · July 1, 2026
